description: The desired state of a global choice. Options left out are kept.

solution.description: Unique name of the unmanaged solution the changes go into. Its publisher decides the prefix.

name.description: Name of the global choice with the publisher prefix, for example con_priority.

options.description: Options. One without a value is matched by its label; a new one gets the next value from the publisher's prefix.

ordered.description: Order the options as listed (options not listed come after them).
